scope: standard Lost Cities structures used in the Meridian Government central-continent spawning region
production_policy: functional integration and mechanical correctness are tracked separately from architectural quality; progression-breaking defects block promotion, aesthetic imperfection alone does not

design_language.theme: centralized Meridian civic and planning language
principles: readable centralized planning and standardized civic construction
a recurring central-seeming organizing element may appear as intentional Meridian lore rather than accidental repetition
shared structural bays, service logic and municipal standards may repeat while individual buildings retain distinct purpose and silhouette
real-world function, circulation, service access and utility logic take priority over decorative novelty

rules: Prefer simple vanilla structural blocks for primary massing, walls, slabs, stairs, roofs, glazing and utility representation.
Use modded blocks or entities only when their use is mechanically justified, integration-safe and materially improves the structure's purpose or gameplay.
Do not make standard city structures dependent on decorative mod blocks when vanilla geometry communicates the same function.
Preserve existing IDs, palettes, Lost Cities assumptions, loot/spawner conventions and quest/evidence hooks unless an authoritative integration change requires otherwise.

required_states.intent: intact pre-collapse reference/master; fully legible original use
maintenance failure, weathering and localized non-structural damage
long abandonment, partial envelope failure, vegetation/debris and service-system loss
localized hazardous occupation or environmental contamination while original function remains inferable
major physically coherent structural failure while enough remains to identify original use and support gameplay

state_rule: Create a state only where technically appropriate for the Lost Cities placement model; never produce five palette-swapped clones. Derivatives must follow a localized physical/environmental story from an intact master.

families.identity_gate: A tower must communicate its actual use through floor program, public/service circulation and skyline form rather than facade palette alone.

heavy_rebuild_review: Confirm parse/load validity, dimensions, origin, ground plane and rotations.
Confirm road/lot/terrain connectors and Lost Cities placement compatibility.
Confirm readable primary entrance plus believable service access where the archetype requires it.
Confirm every occupied floor has usable horizontal and vertical circulation; reject sealed or impossible rooms.
Confirm room purpose, sanitation, storage, mechanical/service spaces and rooftop treatment appropriate to building use.
Confirm facade depth, structural bays, windows and roofline correspond to internal program.
Confirm containers, loot markers, spawners, evidence and quest hooks remain mechanically valid.
Render/review exterior A, exterior B, roof-off/cutaway and floor slices for substantial buildings.
Generate damage-state derivatives from the intact master and revalidate each derivative.
Keep production approval separate from static rebuild completion; in-world review remains required where the existing pipeline requires it.

initial_execution.reason: skyscrapers and mixed-use downtown buildings were explicitly restored to the heavy-rebuild scope and exercise the strictest circulation, service, vertical-core and damage-state requirements
first_pass: inventory all existing Meridian-eligible high-rise and downtown mixed-use structures without renaming authoritative IDs
classify each by actual program and current functional/quality status
select intact or least-damaged authoritative geometry as the master basis
repair progression/worldgen blockers before architectural polish
apply heavy architectural review to vertical core, podium, service/loading, roof plant and floor zoning
derive only physically coherent missing state variants
run targeted validation and renders before moving to the next family
